## Goal
Finalize docs, run acceptance checklist, and tag `v0.1.0-mvp` release.

## Scope
README/plan updates, Phase 34 checklist, git tag.

## Out of scope
Do not start v2 features — documentation and release only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-721: Update README, implementation plan references, open questions, data models
2. KIN-722: Final acceptance checklist (Phase 34) — all FR/NFR verified
3. KIN-723: Tag release `v0.1.0-mvp`

## References
- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md

## What to do
Create `packages/config` with Zod-validated environment loading — one schema per service so missing vars fail fast at startup. Every KinVue microservice imports this package instead of reading `process.env` directly.

## Technical notes
- Package: `packages/config`; use Zod schemas per service
- Labels: backend
